description:
All your AI subscription limits in one liquid-glass tray popover.

Pane shows how much of your session and weekly limits each AI tool has left,
directly from the Windows system tray. It auto-detects the CLIs and apps you
already use (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Grok and more - 18
providers), projects whether you will run out before the reset, computes
local spend with live model pricing, and updates itself via signed releases.
No telemetry; tokens only ever go to their own vendor's API.
What's Changed
- Add a Kimi Code plan card by @ItsJazii in #146
- Release 0.4.39 by @ItsJazii in #147
- Price Kimi Code plan slugs at Moonshot's published first-party rates by @ItsJazii in #148
- Revalidate the spend cache by price probes instead of discarding it by @ItsJazii in #149
- Route Kimi/Moonshot-billed rows from Codex and Claude to the Kimi card by @ItsJazii in #150
- Label the Moonshot toggle and key field Kimi API by @ItsJazii in #151
- Show Cursor credit grants as a bar and bonus usage as a text row by @ItsJazii in #152
- Enable a provider when its key is saved and queue forced refreshes by @ItsJazii in #153
- Release 0.4.40 by @ItsJazii in #155
